To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Chinese PhD students adopted a number of positive stress coping strategies to adjust psychologically to their PhD study in Australia.

the six Chinese students in our study used a variety of strategies to deal with the stress of their doctoral studies in Australia, which were: (1) regulating their emotions, (2) maintaining a strong sense of self, and (3) retaining their motivation.
the Chinese doctoral students adopted positive strategies of emotion regulation, reframing realities and retaining motivation to cope with stress.

the positive stress coping strategies adopted by international doctoral students to adjust to their PhD studies, and the ways that they handle stress in their daily lives.

Chinese doctoral students are able to employ positive stress coping strategies to adjust their psychological well being during their candidature.

Chinese PhD students' positive stress management strategies are a result of the combination of their personal characteristics, the moral education they received, their characteristic motivations for learning, the social support they received and their own efforts.
Chinese PhD students are capable of adopting positive strategies to adjust to their doctoral study.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
international doctoral students can benefit from a positive attitude and an open mind to their doctoral study.
Chinese doctoral students are not only victims of stress but also agents of change.

the psychological well-being of international doctoral students should not be ignored, and that supervisors should be more aware of the stress coping strategies of their students to help them to adjust to the new environment and the doctoral journey.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the psychological adjustment of doctoral students is a complex phenomenon and that it should be examined from a holistic perspective.
the Chinese doctoral students in our study were resilient and able to cope with stress in ways that allowed them to maintain a positive outlook and to remain committed to their research.
international doctoral students are capable of handling the challenges they face and they can do so in ways that are positive.
